notes.title: Patch 1.2.6 (bug fixes and balances)
notes.content:
* Ship encounters are now partially scaled to level rather than completely random.
* Ally mechs are now stronger.
* Players should no longer disappear while hunting space fish.
* Space fish generation has been increased.
* Higher chance at finding valuable loot on planets.
* All quests will now spawn with equal weight.
* Assassin guild counter should now work correctly.
* Higher chance of unique armour during Collector guild missions.
* Less chance to miss with ranged weapons.
* Fixed infinte loop bug while using drones during space combat.
* More minor bugfixes and balances 

-----------------------------------

If you enjoy our games, please consider voting for our latest one on Greenlight! We really appreciate every vote!

notes.title: Apocalypse Hotel - The Post_apocalyptic Hotel Simulator! OUT NOW!
notes.content:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/423700?beta=0

After the alien invasion: the Gogfang began terraforming Earth, pumping out toxic chemicals to transform it into the perfect trans-dimensional, methane paradise… the process should take fifty years.

In the meantime the strange blend of chemicals has begun to mutate the populace, turning some into hideous, fish-people, and reanimating the dead. So far you have been immune to these changes and have fought your way across the country back to your parents’ hotel, hoping they are still alive.

Whether they are or not, you have decided to make a go of it, to repair and renovate their unsightly, sixties-styled hotel into a community where people can be safe from the aliens, mutants, and zombies. Of course… they will have to pay you for the service.
 
[h2]Features:[/h2]
[b]
Improve your hotel:[/b]
•	Repair and renovate the dilapidated hotel.
•	Decorate over 20 rooms in different styles to attract different guests.
•	Decorate your hotel with unique art and objects found in the world. 
•	Craft completely new looks for your lobby and bar.
•	Hire entertainers to improve your desirability.

[b]Attract interesting and diverse guests:[/b]
•	Make people pay for the privilege of staying alive at your hotel.
•	Attract specialist guests like engineers, scavengers, and promoters.
•	Find unique survivors who you can equip and take with you on zombie-slaying adventures.
•	Seek alliances with other races, and build specialist rooms to attract them to your hotel.
[b]
Huge crafting system:[/b]
•	Over 100 items to scavenge and craft into useful tools.
•	Find food in fridges and cook meals for your guests.
•	Upgrade your guns and craft ammo for them.
•	Create useful tools and ‘room packs’ for your hotel.
•	Create special drugs to enhance your zombie dog.

[b]Exciting and scary exploration:[/b]
•	Day and night system where zombies are scarier at night.
•	Drive around a city looking for quests and missions.
•	Explore the streets on foot.
•	Enter every house, sewer, or dwelling.
[b]
Companion System:[/b]
•	Interact with every companion.
•	Equip them with armour and weaponry.
•	Command groups using hotkeys.

[b]Non-Compulsory Storyline:[/b]
•	Interact with three other factions living in the city.
•	Discover why the Gogfang have come to Earth.
•	Save the world from certain destruction?

notes.title: Update 1.1.6 - Big fixes and Crash Fixes
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

So this is a pretty big update that should address the “GMRK:Plane” crash that was affecting some machines. There are also tons of changes to code to make the game run more smoothly across the board and which eliminates a few of the more quirky elements.

With the new baby I’ve been a little quiet on the forum but I am still ploughing away at the game and will have a pretty big announcement concerning it at the end of the week.

Thanks for playing,

Mike

notes.title: Patch 1.1.5 (Lag Fix)
notes.content:
Okay, so sorry I've been a bit dead on the forum these last 24 hours but I have been scripting non stop to fix the lag issues that were occuring on some PCs.

Yesterday I finally got my hands on a PC suffering from the same issues. I have fixed it on that one and I hope that it will now filter down to the rest of you.

As a consequence we are seeing increased frame-rates across all our machines so this should improve the gameplay experience for everyone.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.2 - Drones
notes.content:
Due to popular demand we have introduced drones to the space combat which, should you be able to afford them, will help you destroy or capture the more powerful ships.

There are six different drones each with a single use!

1. Engine disable drone
2. 200 shield boost drone
3. Explosive drone
4. Emergency flee drone
5. Instant Beam-in drone
6. Atomic Drone!

You can purchase them from any Tech Shop 

Have fun!

notes.title: 1.1 Patch - Spooky Space
notes.content:
The spooky space patch adds various bug fixes to the game and a new area of space where players can complete quests to build up their own Space-Station. 

Players will get bonuses for building up certain areas, such as free mech repair for building a mech bay. 

Involves:

     * New quests
     * Special bonuses
     * A new place to hang out when off duty.
